title: My actual dream mall world. I’ve gone here at least 3x a week for the past few years.
content: The lighting is heavily determined by where you are in the mall. Some places are dark, some are bright and fluorescent. My favorite location is the lounge/bar, my least favorite are the rides. God, I hate those rides. It is a mix of my childhood malls, nonsensical amusement park rides, dirty/empty stores, an abandoned grocery store, and a dollar store that you know someone is trying to find you in. The ways to explore are walking, going on amusement park rides, and going down holes/tunnels/slides on the ground or walls. Every bathroom is absolutely filthy, no exemption. The theatre is incredibly low lit, red, and has a lot of people making a ton of noise. It’s like the guests have never been taught theater etiquette. They throw food, yell, pick fights with you, walk around during the movie, ect. The only saving grace is the bar/lounge. It has the best food, it seems to be the dream version of a way swankier Cheesecake Factory. Red, leather, speakeasy vibes. Part of it is a dance floor, and club.
